sources.snippet: This is based on the implementation of Whisper-Small found here. This repository contains scripts for optimized on-device export suitable to run on Qualcomm® devices. More details on model performance across various devices, can be found here. Qualcomm AI Hub Models uses Qualcomm AI Hub Workbench to compile, profile, and evaluate this model.
